name: MonarchToggleBlock
title: ToggleBlock
wrapsNative: DisclosureGroup with a private DisclosureGroupStyle (leading chevron, indented content)
summary: A collapsible section of a document: a summary line with a leading chevron that shows or hides the content under it.
whenToUse: Inside a document, a help article or notes, to fold details under a summary line.
whenNotToUse: For a settings section or a form group with the chevron at the end, use DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch). For a whole list of folding rows, use List with OutlineGroup.
api: init(_ summary: String, initiallyExpanded: Bool = false, expandedLabel: String? = nil, collapsedLabel: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)
init(_ summary: String, isExpanded: Binding<Bool>, expandedLabel: String? = nil, collapsedLabel: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)

options.name: initiallyExpanded
options.description: First initialiser: whether the content shows at first; the block then keeps its own state.

options.name: isExpanded
options.description: Second initialiser: the state the app keeps, for example to save it with the document.

options.name: content
options.description: The content that shows and hides.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: A forward chevron before the summary; the content is removed.

states.name: expanded
states.description: A down chevron; the content shows indented under the summary.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With disabled(true) the summary and chevron take the disabled text colour and the line does not respond.

appearance: The summary is strong body text in the default text colour with a muted chevron before it. The content is indented so it lines up with the summary. No border or fill, so it sits in running text.
platformNotes: The web ToggleBlock also comes as a Tiptap editor node with an editable summary and keyboard shortcuts; iOS has no Monarch rich-text editor, so only the read view is offered. The web names its button "Show section" or "Hide section"; here the summary is the button's label and the state is its value, as with the standard DisclosureGroup. Android shares the name.
accessibility: The summary line is one button whose label is the summary and whose value is "Expanded" or "Collapsed" (the strings of MonarchDisclosureGroupStyle).
The chevron is decorative; it is two different symbols rather than a rotation, so it points the right way in right-to-left layouts.
Hidden content is removed, so VoiceOver does not reach it.
The summary line is at least 44 points high and the whole line responds to touch.
The content appears without animation when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: A long summary wraps; the chevron stays on the first line.
The indent scales with Dynamic Type, so content stays under the summary at the largest sizes.
